purpose: Open-data surrogate plan for every BasinATLAS attribute in the Pskem pilot, with the resolution and fidelity metadata a future geodatabase needs.
release_rule: A surrogate value is an independent open-data estimate. It is never a reproduction of the original attribute and never replaces it.

fidelity_classes.original_source: Same dataset and version as the atlas source.
fidelity_classes.original_source_family: Same dataset lineage, a different release or epoch.
fidelity_classes.open_surrogate: A different open dataset measuring the same quantity.
fidelity_classes.derived_surrogate: The quantity is derived from open inputs by an explicit formula.
fidelity_classes.method_reimplementation: The atlas index formula is recomputed from different open inputs.
fidelity_classes.crosswalk_surrogate: Class legends differ and are mapped by an explicit, imperfect crosswalk.
fidelity_classes.weak_surrogate: The closest open dataset measures a related but materially different quantity.
fidelity_classes.units_mismatch_surrogate: An open dataset exists but its units are not convertible to the stored units.
fidelity_classes.method_not_implemented: Inputs are available; the method is not implemented in this pass.
fidelity_classes.pending_open_source: No open, programmatically retrievable source was in place for this pass.

comparison_policy: Numerical differences against the original attribute are reported as divergence diagnostics only. Agreement does not certify reproduction, and disagreement does not invalidate the original value.

excluded_sources.WWF/HydroATLAS/v1/Basins/level12: An Earth Engine copy of the atlas itself. It is never used to build a candidate value, because that would reproduce the reference from itself.
